scope.purpose: Show free, interactive content in a non-modal panel anchored to a trigger.
alternatives: Dialog for a task that must be finished.

checks.name: npm run validate (schema, consistency, token coverage in 18 contexts, dependencies)
npm run build:tokens (coverage and contrast evidence)

decisionsTaken: Focus policy for non-modal popovers (left open by the spike): focus moves to the first focusable element of the content, or to the panel; Tab order follows the trigger; focus leaving closes it.
label required: the panel is a named non-modal dialog.
Surface color.surface.overlay, shadow.overlay, elevation border, radius.overlay, padding space.content.md, max inline size size.overlay.panel (new, 360 px), offset space.content.xs.
Side bottom or top, align start by default; flips, shifts and follows the trigger on scroll.
No built-in close button: content adds one when it needs it (Escape and a press outside always close).
nextAction: Wave 3 contract gate: present the contract with the other wave 3 contracts and record the approval.
